name: Yuukai Houdou ~Ai Suru Waga Ko no Tame Naraba...
original_name: 誘拐報道～愛するわが子のためならば・・・
source:
Toshiko Misoji raised her son Yuu as a single mother. Everything was happy, until that dreadful phone call no parent ever wants to get...

"I have your kid. Do exactly what I tell you, or he dies."

For the sake of her beloved child, as a mother, Toshiko will do anything. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE144115.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
敏子·三十岁独自抚养儿子优。原本一切都很幸福，直到她接到那个每位父母都不愿接到的可怕电话……

“你的孩子在我手上。照我说的做，否则他就没命。”

为了心爱的孩子，作为母亲的敏子什么都愿意做。

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE144115.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
